examples.name: Missing payment method
examples.query:
mutation CreateOneTimePayment(
  $merchant_uid: String!
  $amount: Int!
  $fee_mode: FeeMode
) {
  createOneTimePayment(
    merchant_uid: $merchant_uid
    amount: $amount
    fee_mode: $fee_mode
  ) {
    transaction_id
    status
    amount
    service_fee
    card_brand
    last_four
    currency
    failure_reason
    created_at
  }
}
